{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Say Hello to Sunshine; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavier alternative rock direction appeals to me, but other albums here fit my current mood more closely.
ItemID: NA; Title: 14 Shades of Grey Bonus Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic heaviness fits my interest in The Reason and One Day Remains, but I would pass this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Vol. 3: The Subliminal Verses; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose its mix of aggression and melody after listening to Ten Thousand Fists and several In Flames albums.
ItemID: NA; Title: Iowa Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try its harsher sound because Advance And Vanquish and Death Cult Armageddon suggest I enjoy intense metal too.
ItemID: NA; Title: Break The Cycle Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for a more melodic, emotionally heavy listen alongside my recent hard rock interests.
ItemID: NA; Title: Through the Eyes Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The heavy sound seems compatible, but I am only picking a few albums and this is a lower priority.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Rise Of Brutality Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Straightforward hardcore aggression is less appealing right now than the melodic or progressive heaviness I have been exploring.
ItemID: NA; Title: Stone Sour Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose its balance of heavy riffs and melodic vocals given my interest in Disturbed and Alter Bridge.
ItemID: NA; Title: Next EX-DLX; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Assuming this is Sevendust's Next, its melodic heavy rock interests me, but I would save it for another visit.
